BOTH PAGES ARE PHOTOGRAPHS printed 180 degrees from upright -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on every page of this report. A figure the pattern misses is not an absent figure (rule 13c). THE ISSUE IS IDENTIFIED BY ITS PRINTED POSITION, NOT BY ITS NAME. The page prints FOURTEEN issue blocks and only nine distinct names: `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` appears FIVE times (positions 4, 6, 8, 10 and 14) and `PRINCIPAL`/`INTEREST` repeat under every one of them. Years run FY2012-FY2030 on page 76 and FY2031-FY2047 plus a `TOTAL` column on page 77. THIS GROUP is the `TOTAL` column of page 77: the three totals printed for each of the FOURTEEN issue blocks, against the `GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL`, `GRAND TOTAL INTEREST` and `TOTAL DEBT` figures the same column prints. WHAT PROVES IT: all three columns tie EXACTLY -- $27,097,991, $9,263,504 and $35,942,791 -- so no issue is missing and none is double counted, and the position-4 `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` block that prints $0/$0/$0 and no year figures at all is included here, which is why the count is fourteen and not thirteen. WHAT THE PAGE PRINTS: the issue at position 7, `MASS WATER POOL 9*`, has a FY2024 PRINCIPAL of $418,704 and its FY2024 INTEREST and TOTAL cells are BLANK. GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL for FY2024 is $846,635, which is the sum of the seven issues paying principal that year INCLUDING the $418,704 -- exactly, to the dollar. TOTAL DEBT for FY2024 is $548,241, and $846,635 + $120,310 = $966,945, so the TOTAL DEBT cell is $418,704 LOW; it is GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL plus GRAND TOTAL INTEREST less that one payment. The same exclusion is carried into the TOTAL column: $27,097,991 + $9,263,504 = $36,361,495 against a printed TOTAL DEBT of $35,942,791, short by the same $418,704; and the issue's own printed total, $5,651,592, is the sum of its TWELVE printed year totals (FY2012-FY2023) while its printed principal total $4,580,191 includes the thirteenth year. Here one CELL in one year of one issue is missing from two derived rows, and the arithmetic locates it exactly. It DOES match what FY2013 and FY2014 both show -- a `MASS WATER POOL 9*` row with a principal and no interest or total -- so the same issue prints the same way in three consecutive reports. closes: the Treasurer's MWPAT loan amortisation schedule for pool 9, which is not published.

proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE AS OF JUNE 30 2011`, PDF pages 76 and 77 of the FY2011 annual town report (4117-fy-2011-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folios 73 and 74. BOTH PAGES ARE PHOTOGRAPHS printed 180 degrees from upright -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on every page of this report. WHY THIS PAGE WAS `refused` AND WHY THAT SAID NOTHING ABOUT THE DOCUMENT: the whole schedule is printed in WHOLE DOLLARS, so the archive's money pattern `[\d,]+\.\d\d` matches 1 of about 300 digit-bearing boxes on p76 and 1 of 79 on p77. A figure the pattern misses is not an absent figure (rule 13c). THE ISSUE IS IDENTIFIED BY ITS PRINTED POSITION, NOT BY ITS NAME. The page prints FOURTEEN issue blocks and only nine distinct names: `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` appears FIVE times (positions 4, 6, 8, 10 and 14) and `PRINCIPAL`/`INTEREST` repeat under every one of them. Keying on the name collapses five issues into one and overwrites their cells. The position is counted off the page top-down and is asserted unique in the generator. THE TABLE IS RULED -- every cell is boxed -- so unlike the trust matrix on pp.73-74 there is no label-to-figure pairing problem here: a figure is in the year column whose box it sits in. Each issue prints three rows, `PRINCIPAL`, `INTEREST` and a TOTAL row named for the instrument (`TOTAL MASS WATER POLL TRUST` -- the page's own spelling, with POLL for POOL -- or `TOTAL MUNICIPAL PURPOSE`). Years run FY2012-FY2030 on page 76 and FY2031-FY2047 plus a `TOTAL` column on page 77. THIS GROUP is the `TOTAL` column of page 77: the three totals printed for each of the FOURTEEN issue blocks, against the `GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL`, `GRAND TOTAL INTEREST` and `TOTAL DEBT` figures the same column prints. WHAT PROVES IT: all three columns tie EXACTLY -- $27,097,991, $9,263,504 and $35,942,791 -- so no issue is missing and none is double counted, and the position-4 `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` block that prints $0/$0/$0 and no year figures at all is included here, which is why the count is fourteen and not thirteen. Thirteen of the fourteen rows also close on principal + interest = total. THE FOURTEENTH IS ATTESTED: THE FY2024 CELL THE DOCUMENT LEAVES OUT OF ITS OWN TOTALS. WHAT THE PAGE PRINTS: the issue at position 7, `MASS WATER POOL 9*`, has a FY2024 PRINCIPAL of $418,704 and its FY2024 INTEREST and TOTAL cells are BLANK. GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL for FY2024 is $846,635, which is the sum of the seven issues paying principal that year INCLUDING the $418,704 -- exactly, to the dollar. TOTAL DEBT for FY2024 is $548,241, and $846,635 + $120,310 = $966,945, so the TOTAL DEBT cell is $418,704 LOW; it is GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL plus GRAND TOTAL INTEREST less that one payment. The same exclusion is carried into the TOTAL column: $27,097,991 + $9,263,504 = $36,361,495 against a printed TOTAL DEBT of $35,942,791, short by the same $418,704; and the issue's own printed total, $5,651,592, is the sum of its TWELVE printed year totals (FY2012-FY2023) while its printed principal total $4,580,191 includes the thirteenth year. Every one of those relations closes to the dollar. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: why. A final principal payment with no interest due, a total formula that stopped one column short, and a payment entered in the wrong row all fit the figures identically, and nothing on these two pages distinguishes them. IT IS NOT FY2015'S EXCLUSION. FY2015's printed grand totals leave TWO WHOLE school-construction issues out of every year column ($29.6M of $49.6M). Here one CELL in one year of one issue is missing from two derived rows, and the arithmetic locates it exactly. It DOES match what FY2013 and FY2014 both show -- a `MASS WATER POOL 9*` row with a principal and no interest or total -- so the same issue prints the same way in three consecutive reports. closes: the Treasurer's MWPAT loan amortisation schedule for pool 9, which is not published.
